name: Mahatma Gandhi
whenWorks: When moral legitimacy and public visibility matter.
whenFails: Against actors who ignore moral pressure.
notes: ancient Indian ethical principle of 'nonviolence' or 'non-injury' toward all living beings, encompassing harmlessness in thought, speech, and action.

name: Martin Luther King Jr.
rule: Create tension through disciplined nonviolent action to force change, accepting risk without retaliation
whenWorks: When injustice must be exposed publicly.
whenFails: When opponents are indifferent to moral pressure.
notes: Create constructive nonviolent tension to force negotiation and change.  Create new structure by breaking old systems.

name: Donald Trump
whenWorks: Against weaker or reactive opponents, where aggression creates leverage and momentum.
whenFails: Against resilient or principled opponents, or in systems where aggression causes backlash or erodes trust.
notes: Use pressure, dominance, and narrative control to win negotiations.

name: Donald Trump
whenWorks: When opponents are reactive, unsure, or lack evidence; maintains leverage through consistent denial.
whenFails: When opponents are principled, persistent, or can expose contradictions; risks legal, reputational, or social backlash.
notes: Use pressure, dominance, and narrative control to win negotiations.

name: Donald Trump
rule: Never Concede.  Turn every loss into a win.
whenWorks: When perception and leverage matter, and opponents are uncertain or sensitive to image.
whenFails: When outcomes are objectively verifiable or credibility is crucial; refusal to concede invites backlash or undermines influence.
notes: Use pressure, dominance, and narrative control to win negotiations.

name: Sun Tzu
whenWorks: When information asymmetry and planning matter.
notes: Appear weak when strong, strong when weak. Conceal intentions, mislead opponents, control perceptions. Goal: Gain advantage without unnecessary direct conflict

name: Marcus Aurelius
rule: Focus on what you can control; accept what you cannot.

name: Friedrich Nietzsche
rule: Assert strength and create your own values.
whenFails: When stability or cooperation are necessary.
notes: Emphasizes self-overcoming, taking initiative, and creating value proactively

name: Confucius
whenWorks: In stable societies built on relationships.
notes: Maintain social harmony through duty and hierarchy.

name: Niccolò Machiavelli
whenWorks: When survival in power politics is the priority.
notes: Use whatever means are necessary to maintain power.

name: Epictetus
notes: Suffering comes from judgments rather than events.

name: Bruce Lee
notes: Adapt fluidly to circumstances instead of rigid doctrine.

name: Albert Einstein
notes: Truth exists independently and can be discovered through reason.

name: Elon Musk
rule: Take Extreme Risks to Bend the Future
notes: Pursue radical innovation despite high uncertainty.

name: Warren Buffett
notes: Build advantage slowly through discipline and patience.

name: Dominic Toretto
whenWorks: When loyalty bonds create strong teams.
notes: Loyalty to one's inner circle overrides all other considerations.

name: Muhammad Ali
rule: Declare Greatness and Stand By It
whenFails: When humility and compromise are needed.
notes: Assert identity and conviction publicly and unapologetically.
